title: Messenger-Style Floating Bubble & Settings-Only Opt-In
releaseNotes: Removed all automatic floating bubble pop-ups; the bubble now stays off unless you enable it in Settings.
Rebuilt the floating Eagle bubble from scratch with smooth spring-physics flinging, magnetic drag-to-dismiss, and idle edge-tucking.
Redesigned the expanded quick-glance sheet with live class countdowns, weather, pending task peek, and one-tap Schedule, Jeep, DC Bus, and Tasks shortcuts.
